units.source_text: 这么一想，千重子不由得要发笑，可自己的脸反倒飞起了一片红晕。

en.t: Thinking this, Chieko could not help wanting to laugh, but instead a flush rose over her own face.

units.source_text: 她只是站着，没把真一叫醒。

en.t: She simply stood there and did not wake Shinichi.
And she even wanted to move away from Shinichi...

units.source_text: 千重子的确从未见过男人的睡姿。

en.t: Chieko had indeed never seen a man asleep before.
